items.rationale: Cause is material ageing, so 7.1.10 confines indemnity to leaking pipe sections and 5.2.6 costs. Assessment falls under 5.2.6(b), cap EUR 3,000; ordinary market price for an assessment call.

items.description: Indoor leak detection incl. technician and vehicle
items.rationale: 5.2.6(a) leak location incl. technician time plus one vehicle charge under 5.2.6(c), still payable under 7.1.10; capped at EUR 1,000 for (a) plus up to EUR 70 net travel, market price likely below the cap.

items.description: Floor covering removal, surface prep, waste disposal
items.rationale: 7.1.10: moisture damage from gradual porosity leakage is not escape of water damage; measures under 7.1.7 and debris costs under 5.2.1 are not indemnified.
7.1.8(b) excludes provisioning for contractor's own personnel; also tied to work excluded under 7.1.10.

items.description: Technical drying incl. labour, dust protection, kitchen disinfection
items.rationale: Drying and disinfection are 7.1.7(b)/(e) measures, expressly not indemnified under 7.1.10 where leakage stems from material ageing.

items.description: Electricity for drying equipment, separately metered
items.rationale: 7.1.7 deems utilities included in the drying lump sum, so a separately metered charge is not indemnified; 7.1.10 excludes the drying anyway.
